source.cohort: Historical teacher-marked Mock Set 1 ResultsPlus submissions: report introduction states 115000 students, 780 centres, around35000 all Foundation papers and nearly60000 all Higher papers. Not a current national examination cohort.

metric: Average percentage of available marks achieved; whole questions calculated from disjoint rounded published part mean marks.
aggregation: 100 * sum(working part means) / source question maximum; explicit source corrections retained in provenance.
